title: Count sheet search finds a part by any column and prints all its bins
custom_preconds: Tracked part with 2 bins, a tag, vendor, manufacturer, category.
custom_steps:
1. Cycle count, search by tag (then vendor, manufacturer, category, cost, quantity)
  2. Print the count sheet
custom_expected:
1. The part is found by each value
  2. Every bin row of the part is printed
